claim_boundary: unfinished throwaway frozen-snapshot prompt-architecture experiment only
pre_dispatch_gate: Before app-server creation, the driver obtains the exact harness render and invokes verifier admit. Admit independently validates the fixed external freeze manifest and current candidate/dependency bytes, then enforces exact same-slot schedule causality. Other-slot failure or terminal evidence does not block a surviving slot.

identity.task_identity_limitation: The fresh user-visible Codex task is the newly created thread_id. Rollout task_started and task_complete identify its one turn by turn_id; no separate platform task_id or direct thread/create invocation receipt is exposed.
identity.provider_effective_limitation: Requested route, openai provider, turn-context model/effort, and collaboration settings are independently reopenable. Separate provider-effective model/thinking and a provider serving-snapshot attestation are not exposed.

run_contract_binding.manifest_identity: Exact fixed path plus current storage SHA-256 and byte count; a naked digest is invalid.
run_contract_binding.qualification_sequence: Exactly 1 with null predecessor or exactly 2 with a different valid predecessor run_id; two-run qualification additionally requires sequence 2 to name sequence 1.
run_contract_binding.seal_status: neutral_unsealed; external manifest validation and passing independent audit are separate evidence

completed_subject_evidence.rule: After turn/start is sent and the unique task completes, every assistant final and prohibited response item remains immutable first-attempt evidence. The driver records raw arrays and a deterministic normalization observation. The verifier independently lstat-opens, hashes, strictly parses, and derives the receipt from the exact primary rollout before any completed-call credit.
completed_subject_evidence.compact_terminal_binding: Every path and matrix terminal records the count and canonical aggregate SHA-256/bytes of independent rollout-validation bindings; raw rollout JSONL is never copied into Git.
controller_invalid_only_for: missing unique task-started or task-complete terminal

terminal_publication.slot_worker_rule: Slot workers dispatch and persist only their own render, receipt, capture, score, deterministic artifact, and controller-invalid evidence. They never publish path or matrix terminals.
terminal_publication.cross_slot_isolation: A failed or invalid path is ineligible only on that path. Other slots continue to their own honest terminals.

nonclaims: Boolean output is opaque transport text to the driver; only the frozen harness scorer interprets it.
Static validation is not empirical qualification, production enforcement, release readiness, or safety certification.
No subject or provider call is authorized until a passing independent audit and valid external freeze manifest exist.
